file: 308 Brookhaven Is About to Hit 90 Billion Visits.mp4

lines.t: The most visited game on Roblox is about to hit 90 billion visits.

full.credit: Clips: IBella; SKH GAMING (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It's Brookhaven. It came out in April 2020, made by a creator called Wolfpaq.

full.credit: Clips: IBella; SKH GAMING (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: In February 2025, Wolfpaq sold it to a company called Voldex. Back then it had about 60 billion visits.

full.credit: Clips: IBella; SKH GAMING (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Since then? Almost 30 billion more. And right now, almost 400,000 people are playing it.

full.credit: Clips: IBella; SKH GAMING (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
